dimensions.assessment_basis: The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: Guardian Australia reported identifying at least 39 submissions to Australian parliamentary and political inquiries containing apparent hallucinated references, including invented sources, incorrect citations and misstatements of real research. In some cases, parliamentary committee reports cited submissions in which many cited sources appeared not to exist. The reporting also described instances in which AI search systems subsequently surfaced or summarised the false references, increasing the difficulty of later verification. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Meaningful but bounded collective, civic, democratic-process, public-institution or information-environment impact.
